title: Student Worker
bio: Adaolisa Agbakwu (she/her) is a sophomore at Harvard College in Mather House from Dallas, Texas, concentrating in Psychology with a secondary in Sociology. Her passion for promoting education around and addressing social inequities drives her work at the Harvard Foundation. Here, she hopes to help develop opportunities for students to access co-curricular academic engagement that enrich their experiences at the College. Area Harvard Foundation
